svg.title: Ville Messenger App Architecture
svg.desc: System architecture showing client, Varnish cache, Nginx, Laravel app, Reverb WebSocket, MySQL, Redis, and Queue Worker

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the React frontend communicate with the Laravel backend?')

sendPrompt('What does the Laravel backend handle in Ville?')
sendPrompt('How does Laravel Reverb handle WebSockets in Ville?')
sendPrompt('What data does MySQL store in Ville?')
sendPrompt('What does Redis do in Ville?')
sendPrompt('What background jobs does the queue worker process in Ville?')
